title: Man on the Flying Trapeze - Foundational Trick

segments.text:
So you’ve mastered the Breakaway from our
previous video, and now you are interested

in learning Barrel Rolls, because, well, they’re
awesome, but you know you need to learn how

to do Man on the Flying Trapeze first and
so you’re wondering, “Can I teach you?”

You better believe it, so let’s do that
now.

The first thing that you to do is throw your
breakaway as I already said.

Next you are going to take your opposite hand
first finger and just set it here and you

When you throw your breakaway the first thing
you want to do is move your hand toward the
yoyo which will slow it down.

Then you are going to move it away from this
first finger which will accelerate the yoyo
over that finger and hopefully onto the string.

Make sure when you attempt to land it on the
string you try to land it very close to this

finger, because if you land it far away it
is very easy to miss.

If you do miss the string with the yoyo on
the outside of the string that means your
yoyo hand is too close to your body.

If you miss with the yoyo on the inside of
your string that means your yoyo hand is too

So as long as you keep both hands aligned
you will hit it every time.
